text:
In June 2026 the median asking rent in Lübeck stood at 12.3 €/m², a 5.1 % year‑on‑year rise and a 32.1 % gain over the past five years, placing the city 16th among the 37 most expensive German markets.  

The market remains balanced with a vacancy rate of 1.5 % and an average of 24 days on market; 26 % of listings are let within a week. Asking rents are about 65 % above the 2022 existing‑rent level of 7.47 €/m², while a typical 60 m² unit costs roughly 738 € per month and the rent‑burden for two residents is 17.3 %.  

A model estimate forecasts the median asking rent to reach 12.89 €/m² in the next 12 months, within a range of 12.6 – 13.2 €/m², implying a further 4.8 % increase.
